entries.en: That's what I like to hear! Let's see what you need.
Fair enough. Let me know if you need anything.
Most people here are. I wish you could take them all down.
Credit where it's due. There's a lot of corruption here. Maybe this will rein it in a bit.
Internal Affairs and Spectres all at once, eh? Anoleis is having a bad week.
Sure. If I wanted to lose my job and get sued into the next spiral arm. Security tracks card use.
Vehicle repairs, of course.
He was corrupt.
That was an Internal Affairs investigator working for the Executive Board.
Maybe you could let me borrow yours?
Anoleis had shut down SI. Looks like he was trying to blackmail them. It happens often enough.
He got caught this time, though. Looks like the Executive Board is going to feed him to the nathak.
He dropped out in the middle of the investigation. Don't know what happened, but word is he's trying to hire bodyguards.
I guess he went too far this time. SI is open again, and Lorik Qui'in is strutting around looking all smug.
I guess he got whatever it was he wanted, because Lorik Qui'in's drinking up the hotel bar now.
I need to leave this station.
Local news
You have one, right?
Repairs.
We found Benezia.
Not me.
I'm sorry to hear that, miss. Your kind live so long, I kind of forget you can die at all.
Commander. There've been reports of noise from the Synthetic Insights office. Would you know anything about it?
Don't play me, Shepard.
Meet me at the hotel for a drink, before you talk to Qui'in. I'll be waiting.
Smartass, hm? That's fine. I can work with that.
Not here, Spectre.
Of course not. Why would I?
It's probably Anoleis' thugs ripping the place apart.
Speak plain. What's your interest?
I'm entirely innocent.
Must be Anoleis' thugs.
Don't be coy.
The elevator does not respond. A small sign on the door reads, "Synthetic Insights temporarily closed."
Freeze! Hanshan security. This office is sealed.
Qui'in? Are you working for him? He's under investigation.
The administrator's orders. Lorik Qui'in is under investigation.
You're the Spectre, right? Lorik Qui'in is under investigation.
Hey, I'm not the one who wants Qui'in. Anoleis has a varren up his ass about this guy.
When the wager is one's life, is calling the bluff really so wise?
Everything the commander has said is true. I'd step aside if I were you.
How do you rate your confidence in that? Ninetieth percentile? Is a 10% chance of death acceptable?
Your funeral, pal.
You're right. They're actually going to let me eat you.
He ain't paying me enough to take on Spectres, or Alliance troops, or whatever.
How about this? You pretend you didn't see us, we'll pretend we didn't see you.
You want to cause trouble?
Lorik Qui'in gave me a pass in.
What are you doing in these offices?
What'll you do if I don't?
Anoleis is paying you to shake this place down. Does Captain Matsuo know you're here?
Anoleis is paying you to shake this place down. That makes you a criminal. I can kill criminals.
Stand aside, kid. Unlike most people you face, we're armed.
Qui'in let me in.
Or what?
You're here illegally.
You can't take us.
I'll have to remove you.
I'm going in there, and I don't want to hurt you. Why don't you just go? We'll pretend this never happened.
I don't have time for this. Get the hell out of here, or I'll start shooting.
You two leave while you can.
Out of my way.
This is suspicious.
What sort of offer did they make you?
Good. I don't think I'm supposed to mention numbers. They'd only write them down on thinstrip.
Full benefits, of course.
Oh, sure. "The company takes care of its own." Full insurance, paid vacations, subsidized housing. After a year, I'd start getting stock options.
You hear about the resort they've got here? At the equator? Bouncebacking, diving, an accredited asajura field...
If you like that sort of thing. I'd rather admire the view.
What do you think about the security? All the weapon detectors, the guards...
Yeah. Did you see the turrets on the way in?
The what?
Turrets. Outside. Big anti-ship weapons. Looks like they could fight off an orbital assault. A small one.
Yeah, but all the monitoring, cameras, and guards. It feels oppressive.
Really? With all the problems out here - pirates and whatnot? This might be one of the safest planets in the Traverse.
What have you heard about Peak 15?
That it's one of the lab complexes. And it's out of contact, or something.
Seems strange. The whole mountain going dark like that? People are pretty wound up about it. Not that they're saying much.
I heard someone say that they do secret weapons research up there.
Ah, people say that about every place they're not allowed to go. "It's got some big dark secret." How 'bout that lobster?
Pretty good. Almost tastes like the real thing. Texture's a little off, though.
You know what I noticed about this place?
People don't talk. Listen. There's like a dozen people in here. You hear anyone but us?
There's that salarian on his comm.
But normally in a place like this, you'd hear--I don't know--I guess "the buzz of conversation?"
No one can talk about what they did at work. Not without getting sued, anyway.
Just seems kind of creepy.
You think you'll take the job?
I'm considering it.
So, uh, if you do, you think we might be able to meet sometime? You know. For coffee?
Coffee? Aw, that's quaint.
Or dinner. A vid. I don't know.
You're here for Elanus, right?
Yeah, I work in superconductors.
I'm here for Binary Helix. We wouldn't see each other a lot...
...unless we both worked on Peak 15.
Yeah, well, it was nice meeting you.
Don't hang up. Elder Brother? It's me. I'm on Noveria now.
I can't talk long. This call is costing 10 credits a minute. It's realtime from the Traverse. Did you think that would be cheap?
I need some information. There's an issue here. With Synthetic Insights.
The manager, Lorik Qui'in. He got caught with his toes wet. The office is closed by Hanshan's administrator.
I need you to see what you can find out about--Are you ready for his name?--Rannadril Ghan Swa Fulsoom Karaten Narr Eadi Bel Anoleis.
No, that's the administrator. The Hanshan administrator. Well, think about it.
A turian wouldn't risk getting his office closed. They don't compromise their "team." That's drilled into them from boot camp.
I think the administrator is using this Qui'in fellow to draw flies from his own clutch.
Of course I could look it up myself! But do you think I'm likely to get any unfiltered data through Noveria's own network?
That, and it would take forever for any out-system search results to get back here.
Thank you, Elder Brother. I have to go. Yes. I'll speak to you soon.
Don't hang up. Is Luhara Chu Niafahl present? Hello Nia. It's Rulamin. Yes. I'm on Noveria. A job interview with Synthetic Insights.
Instructional. I'd swear that every corporation has a former STG operator as their head of Personnel Resources.
It's the quietest place I've visited off homeworld. Everything is built with a good view, and there are constables everywhere. Very secure.
After I get done here, could we meet? It's been years since we heard each other with our real ears.
You're still on Ryskos? Right. I'll do some research tonight and see when I can get a packet there.
I'm looking forward to seeing you, too. I'll be in contact as soon as I have plans.
No. No, they're all on the secure server. Right off the root. Search for fiscals - projections - 2704 - latest. Yes. Right there.
Well, I don't know what to tell you. Maybe Laeta deleted them when she moved into my office.
Listen, I'm on an interview right now. Noveria. Yes.
Well, thanks. Too bad Stoma didn't realize that before he passed me up for promotion. Yes. Good luck with the fiscals.
Don't hang up. Ms. Ellison? It's Rulamin. Well, when I arrived, I found Synthetic Insights had been closed.
A criminal conduct investigation. I want you to keep looking for new positions.
No. I don't care how the investigation ends. I won't risk my reputation working for a suspect office.
All right. When you have some hits, flash them to my VI. He'll collate them for me. Thank you.
No, I don't hold this against you. You've done well for me in the past. I'm just-- It's been a long trip for nothing.
My trip may be extended. While I'm out here, I have some personal business to see to. We'll speak again.
Don't hang up. Ah? That's how salarians greet another over comm channels. Oh, since before we had spaceflight.
I think the idea was that you're disturbing the silence. So you want to assure the listener it's important. Look, I'm not an anthropologist. Do you mind?
That's all right. I need a packet flight from any groundside port on Noveria to Ryskos. Tomorrow. Really? None at all?
Can I assume that's due to security concerns? All right. Six days is the best you can do? Right, that makes sense.
All right, I'll see what I can do here. Thanks for your time.
Shakni! Wish I'd thought of this sooner.
...I listen. Apalon? It's been a few weeks, hasn't it? How are things at the office?
Everyone who came back from Peak 15 is being reassigned offworld.
Since the administrator was arrested, our managers are interrogating everyone who talked to you.
You're the Spectre, right? Management told us not to talk to you.
Something weird is going on at the Synthetic Insights office. The administrator shut them down.
Peak 15 has bio- and cyber-hazard labs. If there is a problem, they should nuke it before it spreads.
I'm sorry. The hotel is off-limits to those without a corporate account.
I can't let you in. You're welcome to enjoy a drink at our café.
We limit access to protect the privacy of our customers.
Chilly today. They should put some mirrors in orbit. Focus some sun down here to warm it up.
You gave my package to the administrator.
Next time, ask whose property you're giving away.
I'm not stupid. I have nothing to gain by attacking you at this point.
I don't blame you. I'd have done the same.
Opold and I, though-- We're going to have a long talk.
Do that.
You've got something of mine. It's past time you handed that package over.
You think I'm stupid? There are guards right over there.
Hrr. That so? We'll see.
Like I care that you know? You his courier or something?
